A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] was taken '''prisoner''' by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] on [[Ter Abbes]]. He was implanted with a [[Yorik-Kul]] slave implant that had been taken from another [[Unidentified prisoner (miid ro'ik)|prisoner]] aboard a [[miid ro'ik]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] while [[Nom Anor]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], and [[Goran Beviin]] watched.
